a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. One concern: there's an 80% storm chance each round, so the plan is risky for both of us. If you want to propose a different fair arrangement, say so openly. Until we both agree to a change, I'll keep my word and operate, and I won't take anything before 8.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
